args.body: Hello, thanks for reporting this. Sorry about the automated fridge questions earlier, please ignore them: we've logged this as a front door problem and treated it as urgent. Until it's looked at, please don't slam the door, and keep people and pets clear of any glass in it. Please close it gently and check it's locked when you go out and at night. If you see cracks in the glass or the door won't lock, tell us straight away. Could you tell us: 1) is the glass in the front door, the back door, or both? 2) does the door still lock properly? 3) what is the door sticking on (does it rub, or is it the latch)? A photo would help. 4) which times suit for access, and any pets or alarms we should know of? We are checking with the landlord on the repair and will update you by 2024-06-10.
